newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: NAFTA HANDLES LESS PRODUCT IN 7-MO 1997.
newsitem.headline: NAFTA HANDLES LESS PRODUCT IN 7-MO 1997.

text.p: Lithuania's Klaipedos Nafta oil terminal said on Monday that it handled 1.807 million tonnes of product in the first seven months of the year compared to 1.938 million tonnes in the same period in 1996.

"We handled less oil products and fertilisers during the first seven months of the year since we were operating two out of three railway lines," the head of the firm's commerce department, Larisa Babich, told Reuters.
Babich also said that the third railway line was undergoing upgrading works, which will continue until October.
"When we finish the reconstruction of the third line we will upgrade the second one and will operate with two railway lines untill the end of the year," Babich said.
She also said that in July the firm handled 386,000 tonnes of oil products and fertilisers compared to 356,000 tonnes in the same period in 1996.
The company handled 1.421 million tonnes of oil products and fertilisers in the first six months of the year.
It posted 16 million litas profit and 30 million litas turnover from handling oil products for the first half of 1997.
